description: This file defines a PHP class `Smarty_Resource_Mysql` that implements a custom resource handler for Smarty templates, storing and retrieving template data from a MySQL database.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Mysql
classes.description: A class extending Smarty_Resource_Custom to load Smarty templates from a MySQL database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource, establishes a PDO connection to MySQL, and prepares SQL statements for fetching template data.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves the template source and modification time from the database for a given template name.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the modification timestamp of a template from the database.
